tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A limestone white with a faint blue cast, never pure grey.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, table bodies, menus and any panel that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table header rows, inactive tab track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, table headers on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: bluebonnet
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary buttons, links, focus ring, selected tab. Text-safe on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `bluebonnet-soft`.

tokens.name: bluebonnet-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled with `bluebonnet`.

tokens.name: bluebonnet-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info alerts, the brand badge. Pair with `bluebonnet` or `ink` text.

tokens.name: on-bluebonnet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bluebonnet` and `bluebonnet-deep` fills.

tokens.name: paintbrush
tokens.usage: Indian paintbrush. The one warm accent: highlights, a single call to action per view. Not for errors; use `danger`. Charts use `chart-2`.

tokens.name: paintbrush-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the paintbrush badge. Pair with `paintbrush` text.

tokens.name: on-paintbrush
tokens.usage: Text on `paintbrush` fills.

tokens.name: firewheel
tokens.usage: Firewheel gold, the yellow tip of the Indian blanket. Fills only: badges, text selection. Never text on a light ground. Charts use `chart-4`.

tokens.name: on-firewheel
tokens.usage: Text on `firewheel` fills.

tokens.name: winecup
tokens.usage: Winecup magenta. Visited links. Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Charts use `chart-5`.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links. A bluebonnet's white banner spot turns wine-red once the flower has been visited; links do the same.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `success-soft`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text on `danger-soft`, `surface`, `surface-raised`; fill for the danger button with `on-danger`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` fills.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1. Bluebonnet blue. The first series, and the only series color when a chart has one.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2. Indian paintbrush. The second series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3. Agave teal, the blue-green of century plant leaves.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4. Firewheel gold. Under 3:1 on light grounds, so label it directly or give a table.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5. Winecup magenta.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Series 6. Live oak green. Not `success`: a series that means good or bad uses status tokens instead.

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Series 7. Prairie verbena violet.

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Series 8. Pink evening primrose. Under 3:1 on light grounds, so label it directly or give a table.

tokens.name: chart-9
tokens.usage: Series 9, mesquite olive. Opt-in: close to `chart-6` live oak, so use it only where it sits next to slots 8 and 10, with direct labels or a table.

tokens.name: chart-10
tokens.usage: Series 10, blue sky. Opt-in: close to `chart-3` agave and dark `chart-1`. Under 3:1 on light grounds; label it directly or give a table.

tokens.name: chart-11
tokens.usage: Series 11, lantana orange. Opt-in: colorblind readers can't tell it from `chart-2` or `chart-4` apart from position. Under 3:1 on light grounds.

tokens.name: chart-12
tokens.usage: Series 12, horsemint orchid. Opt-in: nearly the same as `chart-5` winecup in dark mode, so it relies on position and labels.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The "Other" bucket for series past the last color in use (eight, or twelve when opted in). Never a generated hue.

tokens.name: chart-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, lowest. One hue, bluebonnet, light to dark; dark theme runs dark to light so low values recede into the night ground.

tokens.name: chart-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: chart-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: chart-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: chart-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 5.

tokens.name: chart-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 6. Equals `bluebonnet`.

tokens.name: chart-seq-7
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest.

tokens.name: chart-div-1
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp, strongest below the midpoint (paintbrush side: drier, lower, worse).

tokens.name: chart-div-2
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: chart-div-3
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: chart-div-4
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: a neutral gray that means no change. Never a hue.

tokens.name: chart-div-5
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp, step 5.

tokens.name: chart-div-6
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp, step 6.

tokens.name: chart-div-7
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp, strongest above the midpoint (bluebonnet side).

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: One per page at most: landing heroes and empty states.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Peak bloom along TX-16 is expected the first week of April.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Hints, captions, table cells in dense views.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and column headers. Set in caps with CSS, write the source in sentence case.

styles.name: text-mono
styles.usage: Code, coordinates, IDs. Numbers in tables use `text-body` with tabular figures instead.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between a label and its input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between form fields, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups of fields, alert padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Radio buttons, switch tracks, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Panels on the page use a `line` border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Dialogs.
